title: Spectral-Residual Continuous Greedy for Tensor Sampling
summary: Sampling a multidomain tensor from limited measurements is fundamental in structured linear inverse problems. Kronecker-structured sampling avoids the full high-dimensional sensing matrix, but design remains difficult: sequential discrete methods can commit the cross-mode budget too early, whereas standard continuous greedy avoids such early commitment at the cost of repeated state-dependent gradient evaluations.
